definition: Resident population. Figures for years after the last census are projections, not counts.
notes: Additive across places within a level and across disjoint dimension members, but totals (sex=all, age_band=all) coexist with components -- filter, never sum blindly.

definition: Annual percentage change in the consumer price index.
notes: A rate. Never sum or average across places without population weighting.

definition: Gross domestic product divided by midyear population, in current US dollars.
Personal transfers and compensation of employees received, in current US dollars.
notes: Additive across places in principle; published nationally only.

definition: Personal remittances received as a share of GDP.
Number of households enumerated. An institutional facility counts as one household.
Share of the population aged 5 and over who can read and write. The denominator is the 5-plus population, not the total population.
notes: A rate. Never sum or unweighted-average across places; recompute from the counts.

definition: The denominator for literacy. Published because a rate without its base cannot be recomputed or aggregated.
People aged 5 and over who can read and write.
Number of years a newborn would live if mortality patterns at the time of its birth stayed the same throughout its life.
notes: A rate. Never sum or average across places or periods.

definition: Probability of dying between birth and exactly age 5, expressed per 1000 live births.
notes: A rate. Never sum or average across places or periods.

definition: Modelled estimate of women who die from pregnancy-related causes while pregnant or within 42 days of the end of pregnancy, per 100000 live births.
notes: A modelled estimate. Never sum or average across places or periods.

definition: Share of children aged 12-23 months who received diphtheria-pertussis-tetanus (DPT) vaccine doses.
notes: A rate. Never sum or average across places or periods.

name_en: Agriculture, forestry and fishing, value added
name_ne: कृषि, वन र मत्स्यपालनको योगदान (कुल गार्हस्थ उत्पादनको अंश)
definition: Value added from agriculture, forestry, and fishing, as a share of GDP.
Share of total land area used for crops, pasture, and fallow land.
Harvested production of cereal crops per hectare of harvested land.
notes: A rate. Never sum or average across places or periods.

definition: Gross production of all edible agricultural commodities, indexed to a 2014-2016 base of 100.
notes: An index. Never sum or average across places or periods.

definition: Share of the population with access to electricity.
Share of the population who used the Internet in the last three months.
Mobile cellular subscriptions per 100 people, including prepaid accounts active in the last three months.
notes: A rate. Not additive. Can exceed 100.

definition: Share of the population with primary reliance on clean fuels and technologies for cooking.
Share of total land area classified as forest.
Share of total territorial area under terrestrial and marine protection.
notes: A share. Not additive. Published from 2013 only.

definition: Population-weighted mean annual exposure to fine particulate matter small enough to enter the lungs.
notes: Not additive across places or periods.

definition: Territorial carbon dioxide emissions, excluding land use change and forestry, divided by population.
Modelled ILO estimate of the share of the labour force without work but available for and seeking employment.
Modelled ILO estimate of the share of the population aged 15 and over that is economically active.
Modelled ILO estimate of the share of total employment in the agriculture sector.
Modelled ILO estimate of the female labour force participation rate as a percentage of the male rate.
Tax revenue collected by general government, as a share of GDP.
General government revenue from taxes and other sources, excluding grants, as a share of GDP.
General government spending on goods and services, excluding capital expenditure, as a share of GDP.
Total outstanding central government debt, as a share of GDP.
notes: A share. Not additive. Nepal's debt reporting to this series lags several years; the latest published figure is for 2021, not the current year.
